thread:
nina (dev): Hey, trying the Go quickstart for the first call. Using sdk-go v0.3.1 from the examples. Request returns 401 and body shows "workspace_restricted". I confirmed API key in env.

olivia (devex): Hi! Can you paste the exact curl or snippet you used? Also did you complete billing in the console?

nina (dev): Code: `client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp, err := client.Chat.Create(ctx, req)`
Errors: `status 401: workspace_restricted: routes require enabled billing`

marc (sdk-go): Thanks, Nina. There's a parity bug between Go and TS SDKs around how 401 payloads are surfaced. Go was returning a generic 401 without the structured hint. We just released v0.3.2 that surfaces `workspace_restricted` explicitly. Upgrade may show a friendlier message.

pete (billing): I checked your org (nina-dev-org). Billing shows "payment method required". We have an auto-unlock flow for first-time devs; DM me your org id and I can enable a short dev unlock.

nina (dev): I thought the free tier covered quickstart endpoints. The console had a banner but it was easy to miss.

marc (sdk-go): Two SDK action items: 1) land a patch so the Go quickstart checks for the structured field and prints: "Workspace restricted: add payment method or request a dev unlock"; 2) add a retry for 429/5xx (defaults were 0 retries, we bumped to 2 in next minor).

olivia (devex): I'll update the Go example README to call out billing gating and pin sdk-go>=0.3.2. Also adding a tiny diagnostic example to show `workspace_restricted` and link to billing docs.

deploy-bot: Auto: Created ticket BILL-3210 assigned to pete for dev unlock.

pete (billing): Dev unlock enabled for nina-dev-org for 24h. You should be able to make the first call in ~30s. Also emailed steps to add a payment method to avoid future interruptions.

nina (dev): Re-ran with sdk-go v0.3.2 and unlock applied. First call succeeded. Thanks all :party:
__notes: Slack thread. Messages are chronological and prefixed by display names.
